Source: shape: convert the in1 POP (or demo shape) to points. image: build a point heightfield from the in2 depth/luma TOP.
Density: Point grid resolution per side (more = finer cloud, slower).
Dissolve: Manual dissolve amount, 0 = intact to 1 = fully eroded. Used when Auto is off.
Auto: On: dissolve cycles automatically (12 s per cycle). Off: drive Dissolve yourself.
Autocycles: Number of dissolve cycles per 12 s period when Auto is on.
Automax: Peak dissolve reached by the automatic cycle (0-1).
Wavemode: Shape of the erosion front. plane: sweeps along the axis. sphere: orbiting sphere. radial: expands from the centre.
Axisx: X component of the plane or sphere axis direction.
Axisy: Y component of the plane or sphere axis direction.
Axisz: Z component of the plane or sphere axis direction.
Edgewidth: Width of the glowing erosion edge, in world units.
Scatter: How far eroded points fly away from the surface, in world units.
Jitter: Random per-point offset of the eroded points (0-1). Higher = more dust-like.
Drift: Speed of the curl-noise drift of eroded points. Negative reverses.
Noisefreq: Spatial frequency of the curl noise. Higher = smaller swirls.
Noisecycles: Integer noise cycles over the loop so the animation repeats seamlessly.
Depth: Height of the displacement from the depth/luma image when Source is image, in world units.
Invertluma: Invert the in2 image before using it as height.
Resolution: Output size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Demoshape: Shape used when in1 is unconnected. blob, sphere or torus.
Pointsize: Point sprite size in pixels in the preview.
Brightness: Brightness of the points in the preview.
Edgeglow: Extra brightness of points on the erosion edge.
Glow: Amount of soft glow in the preview.
Camdist: Preview camera distance in world units.
Camheight: Preview camera height in world units.
Orbitturns: Whole camera orbits per preview cycle.
Fov: Preview camera field of view in degrees.
